25121.source: It's always dramatic when someone slides all the way up the neck to play a screaming solo on the higher frets. There is a cool trick that can get you there sooner than you might think.  {L}{L}Every Scale Shape has an exact copy of itself 12 frets higher on the neck. That position is an Octave higher. An easy way to jump 12 frets quickly is to pretend that the first dot after the double dots is actually 3{C} the second is a 5{C} and so on. {L}{L}In the next Session{C} try sliding up 12 frets to that higher Octave.

25121.final: 当有人沿琴颈滑到高把位，奏出高亢的独奏时，总是很有表现力。有个巧妙的方法能让你更快找到那个位置。{L}{L}每个音阶指型在高 12 品的位置都有一个完全相同的指型，音高高一个八度。要快速上移 12 品，可以把双点标记后的第一个圆点当作第 3 品{C}第二个当作第 5 品{C}以此类推。{L}{L}在下一次即兴演奏中{C}试着向上滑 12 品，到达高一个八度的位置。
25121.reason: 修复指型，避免高八度音程位置的生硬表达。
